description: Mechanical gates for Shesha form authoring: validate-on-write (guardrails + styled-ness on any form markup written to disk) and a Stop-time persistence gate (a session that authored forms may not end while the push ledger shows unpushed/unverified work). Plus permanent session-activity logging: one log tree per session, pinned at the git toplevel (resolved once via a tmpdir pointer file, so it stays stable even when tools run from different cwds) at <root>/.claude-designer-logs/logs/<sessionId>/log.DDMMYYYY.txt. PostToolUse lines are prefixed TOOL-FAIL when the tool reported an error/non-zero exit; Stop appends a USAGE line with whatever cost/token fields the payload carries (or 'none-reported'), followed by a BROWSER line counting the session's browser cost off its own log lines ('<n> instrument-boots, <m> mcp-calls', or 'unknown' when the log tree is unreadable) — the measurement behind the one-browser-boot-per-verify-cycle tiers. Note: PostToolUse:* logging plus the Write|Edit validate hook means two Node process spawns per file write — a known, accepted cost.
